name: Għar il-Katidral
description: Cathedral Cave (Blue Dome) near Wied il-Għasri, on the stretch from Forna Point to Reqqa Point. The entrance starts at 5 m; inside you surface in a huge dome lit blue by the light coming through the water. Outside, depths reach 30 m.
conditions: Sheltered inlet. Best between 10:00 and noon. Reaching it from land means a tough scramble down the rocks.
